## About

An interactive prototype built for a *Referent/in (Geo)Informatik* application at the
**Bundesamt für Naturschutz (BfN)**. It ties together requirements management, spatial data
infrastructure, federal/state/EU coordination, and remote-sensing analysis in a single
cockpit — throughout using real open data drawn from the author's own projects rather than
mock content.
